verdict.rationale: Zapier documents two official CLIs: the Zapier SDK CLI, which explores and runs actions across its apps from the terminal with no OAuth setup, and the Zapier Platform CLI for building integrations. Its docs also say agents can run its packages as a CLI, which fits the AI-native use case. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLIs, deeper documentation of agent-oriented CLI workflows such as command reference and structured output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Zapier SDK CLI lets you explore and run actions across {appCount} apps directly from your terminal, authenticated, with no OAuth setup required.
Zapier Platform CLI enables developers to build integrations using Node.js v22, OAuth1/OAuth2 authentication, webhooks, polling triggers, and HTTP middleware.
Agents discover them on npm and skill registries, then run them as an agent skill, a CLI, a typed Node module, or a local MCP server.
